summary: This is an ordinary 8-K reporting a Master Services Agreement between Range Impact and Vetted Consultant LLC. Vetted Portal will design and build an AI platform for permit compliance; total fees are $626,000 gross ($576,000 net after milestone credits) with a six-month go-live target. The filing is operational in nature with no special-situation significance. No securities issuance is described in detail beyond a warrant mention; the deal is a standard procurement contract.
